ALL VOICED
[Wikipedia - Vowel Sounds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vowel#Audio_samples)

# Monophthong
- Vowel whose quality does not change over the duration
- Pure
- Stable
- Speech apparatus doesn't transition

# Diphthong
- Glides from one quality to another
- Gliding
- Two targets
	- Tongue and/or other parts  of speech apparatus
		- Moves between
- No highway cowboy
- Often when separate vowels glide naturally in natural speech
	- Also unitary diphthongs as above
		- Heard as single phoneme

[![File:Belgian Dutch diphthongs chart.svg](data:image/png;base64,)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/Belgian_Dutch_diphthongs_chart.svg)
[![File:Orsmaal-Gussenhoven Dutch centering diphthongs chart.svg](data:image/png;base64,)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b6/Orsmaal-Gussenhoven_Dutch_centering_diphthongs_chart.svg)

# Triphthong
- Three qualities
	- [aʊ̯ə̯], hour
	- [aɪ̯ə̯], fire
	- [ɔɪ̯ə̯], employer, "loir"

# Hiatus
- Contrast a diphthong
- Two adjacent vowel sounds that don't glide
	- Occur in different syllables
	- Re-elect
	- Hiatus
		- Hiatus and diphthong

# Stress & Reduction
- Stress
	- Phonemic
	- Distinguishable
	- Insight/incite
	- Increase/increase
		- Noun or verb
		- Initial-stress-derived-noun
			- Stress to first syllable
			- Turns verb into noun
- Unstressed
	- Reduced vowels
	- Central vowel
		- Schwa
		- ə
		- Most common
		- A - about
		- E - synthesis
		- O - harmony
		- U - medium
		- I - decimal
